finalized: order status was updated to finalized successfuly
shipped: order status was updated to shipped successfuly
canceled: order status was updated to canceled successfuly

exceptions.notFound: the requested order was not found
exceptions.create: order was not created successfuly, please contact the support team
exceptions.update: order was not updated successfuly, please contact the support team
exceptions.delete: order was not deleted successfuly, please contact the support team
exceptions.finalized: the order cannot be modified or deleted because it is finalized
exceptions.not-finalized: the order must be finalized to perform this action
exceptions.no-items: the order must have at least one item to be finalized
